record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, replace raw item counts in the existing frequency feature with user-balanced counts: each training interaction contributes 1/len(user_training_history). Apply the incumbent log1p, maximum normalization, square root and input attenuation 1-0.3*feature; keep unseen-item features zero. This may reduce long-history users’ influence on input suppression. Use training interactions only and store the feature in the existing checkpoint buffer. Keep embeddings, topology, readout, loss and optimizer fixed.
